back_translation: The LORD says this: "Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house could you build for me? Or where could my resting place be?
My hand made all these things, and so all these things came to be," declares the LORD. "But this is the one I will look to: the one who is humble and contrite in spirit, and who trembles at my word.

Whoever slaughters an ox in sacrifice is like one who kills a man; whoever offers a lamb, like one who breaks a dog's neck; whoever presents a grain offering, like one who offers pig's blood; whoever burns memorial incense, like one who blesses an idol. They have chosen their own ways, and their souls delight in their abominations.

So I also will choose harsh punishment for them and bring upon them what they dread, because when I called, no one answered; when I spoke, no one listened. They did what was evil in my eyes and chose what I did not delight in."

Hear the word of the LORD, you who tremble at his word: "Your brothers who hate you and cast you out because of my name have said, 'Let the LORD be glorified, that we may see your joy!' But it is they who will be put to shame.
Listen! An uproar from the city! A sound from the temple! It is the voice of the LORD, repaying his enemies in full!
"Before she went into labor, she gave birth; before pain came upon her, she delivered a son.

Who has ever heard of such a thing? Who has ever seen such things? Can a land be born in one day? Can a nation be delivered in a single moment? Yet as soon as Zion was in labor, she gave birth to her children.
"Shall I bring to the moment of birth and not deliver?" says the LORD. "Shall I, the one who delivers, shut the womb?" says your God.
Rejoice with Jerusalem and be glad in her, all you who love her; rejoice greatly with her, all you who mourn over her,
so that you may nurse and be satisfied from the breast of her comfort, so that you may drink deeply and delight in the abundance of her glory."

For the LORD says this: "Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the nations like an overflowing stream. You will nurse and be carried on the hip, and be dandled on the knees.
As a mother comforts her child, so I will comfort you; and you will be comforted in Jerusalem."
When you see this, your heart will rejoice, and your bones will sprout like new grass. Then the hand of the LORD will be made known to his servants, but his indignation to his enemies.
For behold, the LORD will come with fire, and his chariots like a whirlwind, to vent his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.
For the LORD will execute judgment on all flesh with fire and with his sword, and many will be those slain by the LORD.

The LORD declares: "Those who consecrate and purify themselves to enter the gardens, following the one leading the rite in the middle, eating the flesh of pigs, detestable creeping things, and rats — they will come to their end together.
"And as for me, I know their deeds and their thoughts, and I am coming to gather all nations and tongues; and they will come and see my glory.

I will set a sign among them, and I will send some of the survivors to the nations — to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud the bow-drawers, to Tubal and Javan, to the distant islands that have never heard my fame or seen my glory — and they will proclaim my glory among the nations.

And they will bring all your brothers from all the nations as an offering to the LORD — on horses, on chariots, on wagons, on mules, and on swift camels — to my holy mountain, Jerusalem," says the LORD, "just as the Israelites bring a grain offering in a clean vessel to the house of the LORD.
The LORD says: "And from among them too I will take some to be priests and Levites."
The LORD declares: "For as the new heavens and the new earth that I will make will endure before me, so your offspring and your name will endure.
The LORD says: "And it will be that from one New Moon to the next and from one Sabbath to the next, all flesh will come to worship before me."
"And they will go out and look on the corpses of the men who rebelled against me; for their worm will not die, and their fire will not be quenched, and they will be an abhorrence to all flesh."
